name: itu_bs2051_system_b
character: ITU-R BS.2051 System B (0+5+0): the five-loudspeaker ring at listener ear level with one low-frequency channel, azimuths clockwise from front centre.
sources: ITU-R BS.2051-3: System B (0+5+0) nominal loudspeaker positions: front pair at 30 degrees, centre, surrounds at 110 degrees. Nominal values inside the ranges the Recommendation allows; re-read the Recommendation before treating them as a room specification

ITU-R BS.1770: +1.5 dB weighting for surround channels in the loudness measurement, the low-frequency channel left out. The same weight on the overhead channels follows the other layouts of this engine and is a starting value: the Recommendation does not settle a weight for elevated channels

ITU-R BS.775-3 Annex: fold-down coefficients 1.0 for front L/R, 0.7071 for centre and each surround; 0.7071 for the front overhead pair and 0.5 for the rear overhead pair are starting values carried over from the 7.1.4 layout of this engine

The low-frequency block, the shared-reverb spread, the decorrelation amounts and the gate windows are copied from the 7.1.4 layout and are starting values for this layout: none has been measured on a 5.1 room
